messages:
elaine: Hey team — kickoff for the joint perf bench with Jovian Hardware next week. Primary goals: establish perf/W baseline for our 7B and 70B configs, validate kernel tunings, and produce a short checklist for marketplace listing. Hugo from Jovian is on thread.

hugo: Thanks @elaine — Jovian can supply 4x A2-style boards (2 ops racks) for the week of 2025-06-09. We can snapshot firmware at v1.2.0. What telemetry do you need?

frank: Perf goals I propose: 200W max sustained, >60 tok/s for 70B @ seq=512 p95 latency <= 250ms; for 7B target 600 tok/s per board. Perf/W sweep: quantization {int8, q4f16}, KV cache warm/cold, and batch sizes {1,4,8}.

kai: Re: kernel tuning — we have a branch that adjusts fused-attn tiling; still flaky on long sequences. If we run the sweep on canary images we should pin kernel ABI and record module hashes. Also need to ensure power cgroups applied consistently.

pmaria: For marketplace listing we need 1) pass/fail criteria (latency & perf/W), 2) representative prompt set + cost estimate, 3) recommended config snippets and default RBAC. Can we get a 1-page blurb after the run?

hugo: Sounds good. We'll export BMC power logs + per-board thermal sensors. We can also provide baseline driver image and access to remote KVM.

frank: Quick test matrix draft (short):
- models: rwkv-7b-like (7B-opt), redwood-70b-v1
- seq lens: 128, 512, 1024
- quant: fp16, int8, q4f16
- batch: 1,4,8
- kernels: stock, tiled-fused (kai branch)
- runs: cold start, warm-KV

kai: Add a controlled noise generator for SLO tests (to simulate variable CPU/IO jitter). Also will instrument a perf counter for GPU SM utilization.

benchbot: Scheduled: bench-run 2025-06-10T09:00Z -> 2025-06-11T18:00Z. Artifacts will be uploaded to /bench-results/jovian-2025-06 (public link will be shared).

elaine: Nice. Owners: frank = bench lead, kai = kernel lead, hugo = hardware liaison. Action items:
- hugo: confirm firmware image + KVM creds by Friday (2025-06-06)
- frank: push run matrix to CI and add short prompt set (aim for <100 prompts representative)
- kai: prepare canary kernel image and a short rollback plan
- pmaria: draft marketplace blurb template (1 paragraph + bullet config)

hugo: Will confirm firmware+creds by EOD Thursday. Also can provide a 30-minute walkthrough on the test harness.

frank: Uploading initial harness config snippet now:
```yaml
run_name: jovian-early-sweep
models:
  - name: redwood-70b-v1
    quant: q4f16
  - name: redwood-7b-opt
    quant: int8
seq_lens: [128,512]
batches: [1,4]
metrics: [tokens_per_second, power_watts, p95_latency]
```

kai: Quick note: when you push the canary kernel to CI, tag images with `kernel:tiled-v1` and `kernel:stock-v1` so benchbot can pick them explicitly. Otherwise artifact diffs are annoying.

pmaria: I'll draft the blurb and share in #partnerships tomorrow. Template will include recommended instance types, default batch and quant settings, and a note about expected perf/W ranges.

elaine: One more ask — can we capture a short before/after showing perf/W with and without prefix caching for the 70B run? That helps our docs team.

frank: Yep — will include cold vs prefix-cached runs and annotate artifacts.

benchbot: Reminder: Please attach `bench.yaml` to the CI run. Missing config will fail the scheduled sweep.

hugo: Thanks all — excited to get this going. We’ll sync again once creds + firmware confirmed. :rocket:

elaine: Thanks — will schedule a 30m dry-run call one day before the sweep. :calendar:
